            # Convert the prefix to a tuple to ensure it's hashable.
            # Handles cases where input is shorter than prefix_block_size.
            prefix = tuple(req.input[:prefix_block_size])

            # If request has no input or input is None, use an empty tuple as a default hashable value.
            prefix = ()

        # The formula (hash(x) % N + N) % N ensures a positive result for modulo.
